units: <cite ref="Chagigah 14a">Ḥag. 14ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shabbat 119b:11">Sabb. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ בשעת כִּשְׁלוֹנָהּ וכ׳</he> even at the period of Jerusalem’s downfall (moral decay) the men of faith did not fail her.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 24:16">Prov. XXIV, 16</cite>) <he>תכף לכ׳ רעה</he> the evil immediately follows their stumbling (leaving no time to rise).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 897:4">Yalk. Job 897</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 4:4">Job IV, 4</cite>) <he>היית מנחם כל בעלי כ׳</he> thou didst console all the afflicted (Tanḥ. Vayishl., ed. Bub. 8 <he>יסורין</he>).
